## Description {#details}

<p>This file describes how to lower LLVM code to machine code.</p>


<p>This has two main components:</p>


<ol class="doxyList" type="1">
<li>Which ValueTypes are natively supported by the target.</li>
<li>Which operations are supported for supported ValueTypes.</li>
<li>Cost thresholds for alternative implementations of certain operations.</li>
</ol>

<p>In addition it has a few other components, like information about FP immediates.</p>
